biotools.summary: FREDA is a software tool for privacy-preserving federated unsupervised domain adaptation in regression, enabling robust learning across distributed, high-dimensional datasets while maintaining full data privacy. It’s particularly designed for small-scale, high-dimensional biological data, overcoming limitations in scalability and generalization.
